title: igs-iec104-runtime station events
description: An event of the station role, as the control API reports it (GET /v1/station/events): its connections, the state of their data transfer, and the commands it judged. Versioned with runtime-api.yaml.

StationEvent.description: One recorded event: its kind selects the fields that follow it.

seq.description: The sequence number, from 1, with no gap while the events are kept.

observed_at_ms.description: The time the event was recorded: milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

connection.description: The identity of the connection, the same in every event about it.

peer.description: The address of the controlling station.
